Beyond Himalayas Ladakh is a travel agency based in Leh, India. We have been curating Ladakh tour packages since 2012 and offer a wide range of travel services, including cultural tours, trekking, trips to Nubra Valley and Pangong Lake. We also provide hotel supplies and car rental services. Our team of experienced and knowledgeable travel experts can help you plan the perfect trip to Ladakh. Contact us today to get started!

I booked my recent trip with Beyond Himalayas, and it was perfection from start to finish! My recent trip to Leh-Ladakh, planned and guided by Stanzzin, was nothing short of magical. We began our adventure in Kargil and journeyed through some of the most breathtaking locations — Leh, Khardung La, Nubra Valley, Shyok River, Pangong Lake, Hanle, Tso Moriri, and Jispa. Each destination felt like a masterpiece painted by nature itself, nestled in the serene embrace of the mighty Himalayan ranges.

The itinerary was perfectly curated — a beautiful balance of adventure, tranquility, and awe-inspiring sights. From the stark, surreal landscapes to the shimmering lakes and the peaceful silence of the mountains, every moment felt sacred. The joy I experienced was immense — a heart full of fun, laughter, and memories that still linger — and yet, it somehow never felt like enough.

No words, photos, or videos can truly capture the raw, untouched beauty of the places we visited. What made it even more special was the thoughtful planning and personal touch from Stanzin, whose deep knowledge of the region and warm hospitality made the entire journey seamless and unforgettable.

If you’re planning a Ladakh trip, I can’t recommend Stanzzin enough. It was an experience of a lifetime.

Well done to Beyond Himalayas- totally recommend them to anyone planning a trip to Ladakh anytime of the year.
